summary.text: Laurie Sweet joined the General Assembly in 2025 as state representative for Hamden's 91st District.

paragraphs.text: Sweet completed a doctorate in Greek and Roman Art at the Ohio State University, worked as an adjunct professor at Ithaca College, and moved to Connecticut in 2011.
Sweet then worked as a birth doula for seven years and was elected to the Hamden Legislative Council in 2021 and re-elected in 2023.
